name: mira-native
description: Capacitor wrapper that packages the MIRA PWA as native iOS/Android apps. The live web app at the repo root is the source of truth; `npm run sync-web` copies it into www/.

scripts.add:android: npm run sync-web && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android
scripts.add:ios: npm run sync-web && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync
